faqs.question: How quickly can I deploy a Zyloop Voice AI agent?
faqs.answer: Very quickly. Zyloop Voice is built for a no coding, no complex setup — just plug and play experience, with a drag-and-drop UI that lets you deploy your voice AI agent in minutes, not days.

faqs.question: How does Zyloop Voice AI work?
faqs.answer: Zyloop Voice connects to LLMs via its API and handles real-time voice input and output. When a request is sent with voice input, Zyloop Voice processes, interprets, and responds using natural language — similar to how a human agent would.

faqs.question: Do I need coding skills to set up a voice agent?
faqs.answer: No. Zyloop Voice includes a drag-and-drop UI to deploy voice AI agents in minutes without writing code.

faqs.question: What are the common use cases for Zyloop Voice?
faqs.answer: Zyloop Voice is ideal for customer support bots, voice assistants, appointment booking, sales calls, IVR systems, and voice-driven workflows across e-commerce, healthcare, SaaS, and fintech.

faqs.question: Does Zyloop Voice support both inbound and outbound calls?
faqs.answer: Yes. Zyloop Voice supports both outgoing and incoming calls, making it suitable for reminders, lead follow-ups, and customer support automation.

faqs.question: What languages does Zyloop Voice support?
faqs.answer: Zyloop Voice supports most languages, with a focus on regional languages including Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Hindi, Kannada, and English.

faqs.question: Is real-time voice response supported?
faqs.answer: Yes. Zyloop Voice supports low-latency, real-time streaming so conversations feel natural and immediate.

faqs.question: How is data security handled?
faqs.answer: Zyloop Voice uses encryption protocols and secure API practices. The platform is GDPR certified and SOC Type II certified.

faqs.question: Can I customize the voice, tone, and personality of my AI agent?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can customize voices, tones, personalities, and conversation flow logic using your preferred LLM prompts.

faqs.question: Can Zyloop Voice integrate with my existing tools and CRMs?
faqs.answer: Yes. Zyloop Voice offers instant API integration with tools like Jira, Slack, Mailchimp, Google Sheets, Zoho, and Gmail.
